name: Environmental regeneration of a minimal capability (lineage-independent persistence, stored route)
status: CONFIRMED (C2-b p 0.0195; C2R-P1 p 0.0037; C2R-P2 p 0.019)
1_minimal_description: After every carrier of ECHO (the low half of COND_ONE) is removed, ECHO reappears faster than it first arose; the route is held by non-carrier, near-functional material (variants within Hamming 16) that copiers re-complete, plus some fresh re-invention.
2_environmental_conditions: z80atlas v3 K40, GRID LOCAL, lifespan 40, 256 cells, MED mutation, COND_ONE paid or unpaid; a copier-rich population that has carried the capability for >= 200 ticks.
3_causal_dependencies: World material: a material-free copier reset is slower (9/16 vs 16/16, median 140 vs 60 ticks). Near-carriers: removing them also slows return (12/16, median 80).
4_failure_boundaries: Shown for ECHO only (1-7 critical bytes). Re-acquisition = first appearance (not always durable). Not shown for any composite (none existed). NEAR arm removes more organisms than REMOVE (no size-matched sham).
5_smallest_specimen: Any C2 world, e.g. e1b_00030 (re-acquisition 20 ticks after removal of all LO carriers at its intervention tick); replay by plan_c2r.py with the pinned commit 3e21631fe.
6_independent_origin_evidence: 16 independent E1b populations (distinct seeds), each its own origin of ECHO; 3 arms per population.
7_ablation: Carrier removal (C2), carrier + near-carrier removal, and whole-population reset (C2R).
8_transplant: C3F (descriptive): a foreign ECHO solver implanted into ECHO-free worlds -> ECHO at end 6/10 vs 4/10 sham.
9_generalization_limits: One substrate, one capability; the reset arm shows ECHO is cheap enough to be re-invented, so the effect size is bounded by the capability's triviality.
10_applicability: Any engine with a population memory: capability persistence should be attributed to stored near-solutions in the population before it is attributed to lineage inheritance; test by carrier removal vs full reset.

name: Error threshold for composite computation (variation-maintenance conflict)
status: CAUSALLY_CONFIRMED and REPRODUCED (F3-P0 p 2.0e-7, F3-P1 p 6.8e-5; fresh seeds F4-R 12/20 vs 1/20 p 2.2e-4; F2 rejects the payment-structure alternative)
1_minimal_description: A replicating COND_ONE composite with 10 competence-critical bytes cannot be maintained at the mutation rate at which ECHO / INC (2-6 critical bytes) are found and kept; it decays downhill to the half-solvers. Lowering mutation rescues maintenance with a monotone dose-response.
2_environmental_conditions: v3 K40, GRID LOCAL, lifespan 40, 32-copy founder transplant, COND_ONE, single-input per-interaction payment (or paired-halves payment), 2,000 ticks.
3_causal_dependencies: Mutation rate (manipulated, seed-matched): kept 1/20 MED, 13/20 LOW, 17/20 VLOW. Payment at VLOW: 17/20 paid vs 8/20 unpaid. Removing half-credit payment: 2/20 vs 1/20 (no effect).
4_failure_boundaries: One hand-built composite (no redundancy). Evolved composites with redundant critical bytes not tested. Low mutation also slows search (F4 tests crossing at LOW). At LOW, one-step precursors still rarely cross (F4: 1/20) and lose replicators (FUNC end 4/20): no single fixed rate both finds and keeps the composite in 2,000 ticks.
5_smallest_specimen: W0 = copier + COND_ONE witness, hex 07000840034015402e80350d2241ff + zero padding; F1 seeds 72.4e12 + 0..19.
6_independent_origin_evidence: F3: 20 populations x 3 mutation levels (+ 20 unpaid); F4-R: 20 further independent populations (seeds 72.5e12+), MED vs LOW seed-paired.
7_ablation: Knockout ladder (F1): 1, 2, 4 critical bytes removed -> no crossing at MED; crossing observed once (F2, distance-1 point repair).
8_transplant: The composite transplanted into fresh evolving populations (F1) is not kept at MED: it does not survive transplantation into a search-rate world.
9_generalization_limits: COND_ONE only; one substrate configuration; 2,000 ticks.
10_applicability: For any evolutionary search over programs: the search mutation rate sets a ceiling on the number of critical sites a maintained mechanism can have; composition experiments must show maintenance of a planted composite before interpreting a failure to build one. Candidate remedies: variable/heritable mutation rate, redundancy, error correction.

name: Copy-length coupling has two separable components (exhaustion vs I/O damage)
status: CAUSALLY_CONFIRMED on 4 specimens (deterministic intervention grid); prevalence not measured
1_minimal_description: An overlong self-copy couples computation to heredity in two ways: it exhausts the shared step budget before the output instruction (input read before the copy), or it overwrites the input slot before it is read (input read after the copy).
2_environmental_conditions: z80atlas, L = 64, I/O at 0xE0 / 0xF0, LDIR 1 step per byte, strict budget.
3_causal_dependencies: Exhaustion: budget-dependent (73 / 9 / 0 failures at 192 / 256 / >= 384). Damage: budget-independent (95/95 failures at c 161..255 at every budget to 4,096). Compute-first machines are immune to both.
4_failure_boundaries: BEL-48H's 'coupling vanishes when budget exceeds copy cost' holds for exhaustion only.
5_smallest_specimen: EVOLVED_W4_00735 (BEL-48H M6, exhaustion type); COPY_FIRST synthetic (damage type).
6_independent_origin_evidence: 1 evolved specimen + 3 synthetic; BEL-48H prevalence of budget-coupled machines 17/41 (type not split).
7_ablation: Copy length c = 0..255 x budget 192..4,096 (full grid).
9_generalization_limits: Static execution only; the evolutionary consequence of each type is not measured.
10_applicability: In any shared-memory VM, the position of a single I/O instruction relative to a copy loop decides which physical constraint couples function to reproduction.

name: Two-component uptake: precursor damage vs assembly (replaces 'uptake suppresses origination')
status: CAUSALLY_CONFIRMED in 2 substrates (D2-P1, D2-P2, p < 1e-14); net block-all effect REPRODUCED in BEL-48H U/U2 and D1, weak and non-significant in D2
1_minimal_description: Horizontal uptake (a partner's bytes written into an organism) acts in opposite directions depending on the importer: into an organism that already carries LDIR (a precursor) it damages it and lowers replicator origination; into one without LDIR it supplies material for assembly and raises origination. The observed block-all effect is the sum.
2_environmental_conditions: z80atlas v2 BASE origin worlds (GRID WELL_MIXED, random init, 500 ticks, MED BYTE mutation), ENDOGENOUS_PARTIAL budget 256 or PAIR_EXECUTION budget 320.
3_causal_dependencies: Selective reversion of imports by the importer's pre-execution LDIR content (tools/uptake_select.py): block_ldir 150 / 111 vs normal 72 / 33; block_noldir 50 / 26.
4_failure_boundaries: Net block-all effect varies: +38% in BEL-48H (GRID WELL_MIXED 256), absent in SOUP and at budget 384 (S1), significant in D1 (2 new substrates), not significant in D2 (82 vs 68 discordant). The functional loss/gain ratio rule (UF2) does not predict it (D1). LDIR presence is a marker, not a measured precursor state; arms block different doses.
5_smallest_specimen: Any D2 seed pair, e.g. S_REF seed base 72.2e12 with the 4 arms (normal, block_all, block_ldir, block_noldir); pin ce4bcd5e7.
6_independent_origin_evidence: 800 independent initial populations in D2 (4 arms each), plus 1,600 pairs in BEL-48H U/U2 and 1,900 runs in D1.
7_ablation: Uptake blocked by importer class (LDIR / non-LDIR / all) on the same seed.
8_transplant: Substrate transplant: holds in PARTIAL budget 256 and PAIR budget 320 (D2); D1 added GRID LOCAL.
9_generalization_limits: Origin-phase worlds (first 500 ticks); effect on later evolution not measured; dose not matched.
10_applicability: In any system with horizontal transfer, the sign of the transfer's effect on innovation depends on the receiver's developmental state; aggregate block/allow manipulations measure a balance and can mislead.

fault_line: Operator-aware one-step geometry does not rank completion better than substitution or byte content in unseen worlds (A3; AUC 0.592 / 0.586 / 0.606); it predicts well only at distance 1 (8/9 vs 37/581).
The UF2 functional loss/gain ratio rule does not predict the uptake-block effect in new substrates (D1-P1 falsified); the effect itself generalised.
Two working half-block replicators do not compose across a verified 4-5-step desert under any of three copy operators in 1,000 ticks (K2: 0/1,320).
Evolved half-solvers of a composite task are whole single-task machines (ECHO 34/34, INC 13/13), not partial composites; 0 one- and sampled three-step routes to the composite.
